chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Isa ibn Abi Mansur, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said to me: When the sun has passed the meridian and you have performed your supererogatory prayer, then the time of Zuhr has entered.

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, whose decline marks the start of Zuhr time
key_terms.زَالَتِ: passed the meridian or declined from the middle of the sky

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr prayer begin according to Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the time of Zuhr begins when the sun passes the meridian. It also mentions performing the supererogatory prayer associated with that time before the obligatory Zuhr salat.
